The flight deck for customer engagement, from Maxicus

Autopilot for the routine. Pilots for what matters. One flight deck.

On a modern flight deck, the autopilot flies most of the journey. The pilots take off, land, and handle the turbulence. And every flight's data makes the next one smoother.

Unifymax runs your customer engagement the same way. AI agents take the volume. People take the moments that matter. Every interaction trains the next one, on one continuous loop between the two. And like an airline, we're measured on arrivals, not on hours flown.

02Why both, not one

A plane with only autopilot never leaves the gate. A plane with only pilots never scales.

AI on its own stalls on the hard cases. People on their own can't keep up with the volume. The answer isn't choosing. It's running both on one loop, where each one makes the other better.

AI workforce
Autopilot

Handles most of the journey. Answers, routes, drafts, checks, and does it at any hour, at any volume, the same way every time.

What it is: AI agents, chat and video bots, agent assist, AI-scored quality.
Human workforce
Pilots

Take off, land, and fly through the weather. The escalation, the sale that needs a conversation, the customer standing in a store or at their front door.

What it is: agents, supervisors, trainers and quality teams, on our floors and yours.
Continuous learning
Flight data

Every flight is recorded. Every recording improves the next route. Here, every resolved case updates the knowledge, the training and the model.

What it is: the loop that makes the first two better every week.
03The platform

Multifold capabilities. One system. Every layer designed for elevated CX.

Six capabilities on one loop. The AI side builds the knowledge, the learning and the analytics. The human side runs the floor, the quality and the engagement. Continuous learning is where the two meet. Click any point to see what it does.

Why a loop, not a stack
Break one link and the loop stops.

A bot without governed knowledge guesses. Knowledge nobody scores goes stale. Training without quality data trains the wrong thing. Agents without AI beside them are slow. Each capability exists to feed the next, which is why Unifymax is sold as one platform and measured as one outcome.

04Outcome-based, not effort-based

Airlines are paid for arrivals, not hours flown. So are we.

Software vendors are paid whether the seat is used or not. Outsourcers are paid by the hour whether the customer stayed or not. Unifymax is paid on the movement of a number you chose before anything was built.

05Professional services

Nothing takes off without the ground crew.

The platform is half of it. Knowledge has to be migrated and written. Teams have to be trained. Models have to be tuned on your data. Our professional services carry the same weight as the products, because without them the loop never starts.

Knowledge services

Moving what you know out of CRM notes, SharePoint and PDFs into answers people and bots can use. Decision trees and guides written by people who have run a floor.

Learning services

Classroom and remote training, curriculum, certification. Mobile-first content for agents, store staff and field teams.

Content and localisation

Multilingual content, video scripts, interactive guides. Built for the channel it lives on, not converted from a slide.

Analytics and AI enablement

Dashboards, models trained on your own interactions, and the integration work that connects the loop to your CRM, telephony and ticketing.

06For brands going direct

Own the passenger, not just the seat.

Every sale through a marketplace costs you a commission and the customer. Unifymax gives a brand its own route: a web store with live video selling and support behind it, run by people and AI on the same loop. One household, many products, one relationship that keeps compounding.

Live video, from your own site

Demo, sell and support on video, from the brand's own storefront, not a marketplace listing.

Built for the whole household

Appliances, electronics, personal care. The second product sold to the same home carries no commission and no re-acquisition spend.

Measured on the numbers that pay

Conversion, repeat purchase, revenue per customer. The same outcome contract as everything else we run.

07Analytics

Your instrument panel. Every number you are paying for, on one screen.

08How we deliver

Simulator hours before the real flight.

Pilots log their hours in a simulator before they carry passengers. We do the same. The metric is agreed in writing. The proof of concept runs on Maxicus floors, with our agents and your data. Only what has already moved the number is deployed to you.
